title: MARC: Mechanism-Aware Reflective Correction for Articulated Object Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33060v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generating an articulated object from images and text requires more than plausible parts and movable joints: the assembled mechanism must execute the intended motion. This is particularly challenging for closed-chain and coupled mechanisms, where an error in one connection can block motion or separate connected parts. We introduce MARC, Mechanism-Aware Reflective Correction, which shares an executable kinematic graph across program construction, motion solving, and correction. The graph binds physical connections to local attachment frames and represents loop closures and joint-coordinate couplings. Given prescribed driver inputs, a numerical solver computes follower motion and associates errors with specific connections and configurations. The agent uses these diagnostics to probe possible causes, revise connections or geometry, and retest the mechanism along the original motion paths. On a 20-object test set, MARC with Kimi-K3 achiev

translated_title: MARC：面向铰接物体代码生成的机制感知反思校正方法
translated_abstract: 从图像和文本生成铰接物体，不仅需要看似合理的部件和可动关节：组装后的机构还必须能够执行预期的运动。这对于闭链和耦合机构而言尤其具有挑战性，因为其中一个连接的错误就可能阻碍运动或使相连部件分离。我们提出了MARC（机制感知反思校正，Mechanism-Aware Reflective Correction），它在程序构建、运动求解和校正之间共享一个可执行的运动学图。该图将物理连接绑定到局部附着坐标系，并表示环闭合和关节坐标耦合关系。在给定指定驱动输入的情况下，数值求解器计算从动件的运动，并将错误与特定的连接和构型关联起来。智能体利用这些诊断信息探查可能的原因，修正连接或几何形状，并沿原始运动路径重新测试机构。在一个包含20个物体的测试集上，使用Kimi-K3的MARC取得了（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MARC提出了一种机制感知的反思校正框架，通过在程序构建、运动求解和校正之间共享可执行的运动学图，实现铰接物体（尤其是闭链和耦合机构）代码生成中运动错误的自动诊断与修复。
en_tdlr: MARC introduces a mechanism-aware reflective correction framework that shares an executable kinematic graph across program construction, motion solving, and correction, enabling automatic diagnosis and repair of motion errors in articulated object code generation, particularly for closed-chain and coupled mechanisms.
